technical.summary: Strong intermediate trend structure with bullish long-term alignment and exceptional volume spike, but short-term momentum indicators lack confirmation and show divergence, limiting swing entry conviction.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signals from junior members combined with market fear (28 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but conviction is low and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (372.96) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide minimal offset; earnings in 73 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, 15x volume spike, and bullish EMA 50/200 crossover with supertrend confirmation create intermediate-term structural strength despite short-term momentum divergence.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (372.96), zero short-term momentum confirmation (RSI 9 not rising, AO negative, EMA 9/21 bearish), no smart money/insider activity, and earnings risk in 73 days outweigh technical structure in unfavorable macro environment.
